text:
Zara (CS): heads-up — NebulaMetrics onboarding demo tomorrow; renewal meeting in 10 days and they're flagged as RISK if the demo doesn't scale. They've requested a 48h regional burst across eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1, plus an IP allowlist and mTLS pinning for their proxy. Can we approve and schedule auto-revoke? @Rafael @Maya

Evan (NebulaMetrics): confirmed CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25. Demo timeline (UTC): 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z. We'll do a staged ramp: 0-10m -> 400 QPS, 10-30m -> 1200 QPS, 30-60m -> 1800 QPS peak. We'll only route demo traffic from the pinned IPs.

Rafael (EngOps): need org_id + project_id and whether this is Hosted or Dedicated. For Hosted we can route to a soft-quota pool with a temporary override and set auto-revoke; Dedicated needs capacity lead signoff (min 24h). Also recommend a canary rollout (5% -> 100%) before full ramp.

Maya (SRE): I'll stand up a short-lived dashboard and alerting. What are expected p50/p95 token rates? I'll set alert: p95_latency > 400ms or error_rate > 2% -> page. Also will add automatic fallback to lower-capacity model variant if latency spikes. Need exact auto_revoke timestamp in UTC.

Zara (CS): org_id: nebulametrics-prod, project_id: demo-2026. This is Hosted. Auto-revoke: 2026-04-04T14:00:00Z (48h). Renewal note: "won't commit unless demo shows stable scaling" — label this high priority and link CS ticket CS-12999.

Rafael (EngOps): prepping config. Will do a staged override with canary. YAML I'll apply after Maya signs off on alerts:```yaml
org: nebulametrics-prod
project: demo-2026
regions:
  - eu-west-1
  - ap-northeast-1
staged_ramp:
  - window: 0-10m
    qps: 400
  - window: 10-30m
    qps: 1200
  - window: 30-60m
    qps: 1800
allowlisted_cidrs:
  - 198.51.100.0/24
  - 203.0.113.128/25
mtls_pin: true
auto_revoke: 2026-04-04T14:00:00Z
notes: "48h demo burst for renewal; CS-12999"
```

Rafael (EngOps): command I'll run: `infractl override apply --org nebulametrics-prod --project demo-2026 --file tmp/nebulametrics-demo-burst.yaml --canary 5%`

deploy-bot: Created ops ticket OPS-10002 to track the override and allowlist. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/OPS-10002

Maya (SRE): approved. I'll create the dashboard and add a pager rule. Canary start 13:45 UTC to validate warmup. Post-smoke, Rafael you can push full rollout at 14:00 UTC. I'll also enable model-variant fallback and synthetic traffic checks.

Rafael (EngOps): applied canary to eu-west-1 at 2026-04-02T13:45:00Z (5% traffic). Smoke test results: pass. Rolling to prod now.

deploy-bot: OPS-10002 updated: canary passed, prod override applied by rafael at 2026-04-02T13:58:20Z UTC. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-04T14:00:00Z UTC.

Maya (SRE): dashboard link: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dash/ops/OPS-10002 — watching p95 and errors. Alerts set: p95>400ms or errors>2%. Fallback policy configured: switch to compact-ml-1 if p95>700ms for >30s.

Evan (NebulaMetrics): demo completed; initial ramp looked good, small spikes at minute 27 but auto-scaling steady. We'll send a short recording and perf logs. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Zara (CS): great — I'll attach the demo logs to CS-12999 and update renewal owner. If metrics stay stable we'll open a follow-up to discuss committed capacity and pricing. Marking this as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:
